title: B16: what's actually on the accelerator cable
ask: You marked B16 (Accelerator cable, PT166) as a different part - what is actually fitted?
why: PT166 is catalogued as the Weber-kit cable (FA01-41-660); until we know what's really there the Manual can't show it and any future carb/linkage work can't rely on its spec.
options:
(a) it's the Weber-kit cable (not the catalogued FA01-41-660) - say what's stamped or how it differs
(b) it's some other cable - describe make/routing so it can be logged
(c) leave it unconfirmed for now - you'll look again next session
recommend: (a), unless you can describe something else
stops: Manual entry for PT166; any carb linkage work

title: B34: what's actually in the brake booster vacuum lines
ask: You marked B34 (Brake booster vacuum hoses and pipes, PT567) as a different part - what is actually fitted?
why: PT012 already records the vacuum lines as renewed; a booster line that isn't the factory spec is a safety item, and the Manual can't show PT567 as confirmed until we know what's really routed.
options:
(a) some factory hose/pipe remains - say which of the four (G001-43-640, 1480-43-830A, 8871-43-836, FA01-43-840) and its condition
(b) all of it has been replaced with something else - describe what's routed now
(c) leave it unconfirmed for now - a booster vacuum leak is a safety item, so don't drive it hard until this is known
recommend: (a), unless it's clearly something else you can describe
stops: Manual entry for PT567; driving the car hard; any brake work

title: B37: what the vacuum hose routing label actually shows
ask: You marked B37 (Vacuum hose routing label, PT974) as a different part - what's actually there?
why: The label was drawn for the factory carburettor (PT006), which is gone; the Manual can't show PT974 as confirmed until we know whether a label exists and what it shows.
options:
(a) the label is gone or illegible - treat it as not on the car
(b) a label is present but shows different routing - describe or photograph what it shows
(c) leave it unconfirmed for now
recommend: (a), unless a label is actually present

title: C4: what's actually in the headlamp buckets
ask: You marked C4 (Headlamp assembly, PT589) as a different part - what is actually fitted, R and L?
why: PT035 already flags that LED housings were fitted by a previous owner but not confirmed on the car; this answer can settle both PT589 and PT035 at once, and the Manual is hiding both until it's known.
options:
(a) LED units sit in the factory halogen buckets - this also answers PT035's own open question about what's fitted
(b) some other headlamp unit is fitted - describe it (sealed-beam halogen, projector, etc.)
(c) leave it unconfirmed for now
stops: Manual entry for PT589 and PT035; any headlamp/wiring work at the front end
